context.title: Identifier (1 General)
context.description: 1.1 A globally unique label that identifies this learning object: a catalog (identification scheme, e.g. URI, ISBN, DOI) and an entry within it.

context.title: Title (1 General)
context.description: 1.2 Name given to this learning object.

context.title: Language (1 General)
context.description: The primary human language used, as a language tag such as en-US or fr (ISO 639 language, optional ISO 3166 country).

context.title: Description (1 General)
context.description: 1.4 A textual description of the content of this learning object.

context.title: Keyword (1 General)
context.description: 1.5 A keyword or phrase describing the topic of this learning object. HLOM: use the Source and ID columns to reference a clinical terminology such as MeSH, SNOMED or UMLS (e.g. MeSH D009203).

context.title: Coverage (1 General)
context.description: 1.6 The time, culture, geography or region to which this learning object applies.

context.title: Structure (1 General)
context.description: 1.7 Underlying organizational structure of this learning object.

context.title: Aggregation level (1 General)
context.description: 1.8 The functional granularity of this learning object (1 = raw media, 4 = largest, e.g. a course or set of courses).

topic.label: Aggregation level in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Version (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: 2.1 The edition of this learning object.

context.title: Status (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: 2.2 The completion status or condition of this learning object.

context.title: Contribute (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: 2.3 Entities (people, organizations) that have contributed to the state of this learning object during its life cycle. HLOM: use the date of the publisher's contribution as release date and the reviewer's as review date.

context.title: Role (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: Kind of contribution. HLOM adds the roles reviewer, programmer, producer, director and other.

context.title: Entity (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: The contributing person or organization, as a vCard (BEGIN:VCARD ... END:VCARD).

context.title: Date (2 Life Cycle)
context.description: The date of the contribution (YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss with optional time zone).

context.title: Meta identifier (3 Meta-Metadata)
context.description: 3.1 A globally unique label that identifies this metadata record.

topic.label: Meta identifier in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Meta contribute (3 Meta-Metadata)
context.description: 3.2 Entities that have affected the state of this metadata record (creator, validator).

topic.label: Meta contribute in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Metadata schema (3 Meta-Metadata)
context.description: 3.3 The metadata specifications this record conforms to. HLOM requires LOMv1.0 and HEALTHCARE_LOMv1 (and SCORM_CAM_v1.3 if applicable).

topic.label: Metadata schema in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Meta language (3 Meta-Metadata)
context.description: 3.4 Language of this metadata record; the default for strings without a language attribute.

topic.label: Meta language in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Format (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.1 Technical data type(s) of the components of this learning object, as MIME types (or "non-digital").

context.title: Size (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.2 The size of the digital learning object in bytes.

context.title: Location (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.3 A string (usually a URL) used to access this learning object.

context.title: Requirement (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.4 The technical capabilities necessary for using this learning object. All conditions of a requirement are alternatives (OR).

context.title: Installation remarks (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.5 Description of how to install this learning object.

topic.label: Installation remarks in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Other platform requirements (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.6 Information about other software and hardware requirements.

topic.label: Other platform requirements in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Duration (4 Technical)
context.description: 4.7 Time a continuous learning object takes when played at intended speed, as an ISO 8601 duration such as PT1H30M.

context.title: Educational (5 Educational)
context.description: 5 Key educational or pedagogic characteristics of this learning object. A record may describe several educational uses.

context.title: Interactivity type (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.1 Predominant mode of learning supported (active, expositive or mixed).

topic.label: Interactivity type in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Learning resource type (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.2 Specific kind of learning object. HLOM adds animation, audio, case study, collaborative forum, game, image, reference, tutorial, video and virtual patient.

topic.label: Learning resource type in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Interactivity level (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.3 The degree of interactivity.

topic.label: Interactivity level in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Semantic density (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.4 The degree of conciseness of this learning object.

topic.label: Semantic density in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Intended end user role (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.5 Principal user(s) for which this learning object was designed.

topic.label: Intended end user role in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Context (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.6 The principal environment within which use of this learning object is intended. HLOM adds patient, caregiver and professional education contexts.

context.title: Typical age range (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.7 Age of the typical intended user, e.g. 7-9 or 18-.

topic.label: Typical age range in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Difficulty (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.8 How hard it is to work with this learning object for the typical intended audience.

context.title: Typical learning time (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.9 Approximate or typical time it takes to work with this learning object (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT45M).

topic.label: Typical learning time in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Educational description (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.10 Comments on how this learning object is to be used.

topic.label: Educational description in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Educational language (5 Educational)
context.description: 5.11 The human language used by the typical intended user.

topic.label: Educational language in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Cost (6 Rights)
context.description: 6.1 Whether use of this learning object requires payment.

context.title: Copyright and other restrictions (6 Rights)
context.description: 6.2 Whether copyright or other restrictions apply to the use of this learning object.

topic.label: Copyright and other restrictions in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Rights description (6 Rights)
context.description: 6.3 Comments on the conditions of use of this learning object.

topic.label: Rights description in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Relation (7 Relation)
context.description: 7 Relationships between this learning object and other learning objects.

context.title: Kind (7 Relation)
context.description: 7.1 Nature of the relationship between this learning object and the target learning object.

context.title: Resource (7 Relation)
context.description: 7.2 The target learning object of this relationship, identified by catalog and entry.

context.title: Annotation (8 Annotation)
context.description: 8 Comments on the educational use of this learning object, with information on when and by whom they were created.

context.title: Classification (9 Classification)
context.description: 9 Describes where this learning object falls within a classification system. HLOM uses classification for curriculum classification, educational objectives, competencies (e.g. ACGME), learning outcomes, guidelines, drug lists and levels of evidence.

context.title: Purpose (9 Classification)
context.description: 9.1 The purpose of classifying this learning object. HLOM adds clinical guideline, drug list, level of evidence and learning outcome.

context.title: Taxon path (9 Classification)
context.description: 9.2 A taxonomic path in a specific classification system, from the most general to the most specific taxon.

topic.label: Taxon path in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Taxon source (9 Classification)
context.description: 9.2.1 The name of the classification system, e.g. ACGME Core Competencies or MeSH.

topic.label: Taxon source in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Taxon (9 Classification)
context.description: 9.2.2 A particular term within the taxonomy: an identifier and a textual label.

context.title: Healthcare metadata (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: healthcareMetadata contains metadata specific to healthcare education. healthcareMetadata must occur once if Healthcare LOM is being used.

topic.label: Healthcare metadata in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Healthcare education (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: healthcareEducation is the subelement of healthcareMetadata and defines healthcare specific metadata for educational offerings.

topic.label: Healthcare education in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Expiration date (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: expirationDate indicates the date after which this educational offering is no longer considered valid.

topic.label: Expiration date in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Credits available (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: creditsAvailable indicates whether or not credits are offered for the educational offering.

topic.label: Credits available in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Credits (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: credits defines the credits that may be awarded for this educational offering. If an activity is certified for more than one type of credit (i.e. CME and CNE), add one credits entry per type of credit.

context.title: Target audience (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: targetAudience contains subelements that describe the target audience for this educational offering.

topic.label: Target audience in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Activity location (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: activityLocation indicates the geographical location in which an in person activity takes place.

topic.label: Activity location in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Start date time (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: startDateTime indicates the date and time that a live activity begins.

topic.label: Start date time in the HLOM Guide

context.title: End date time (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: endDateTime indicates the date and time that a live activity ends.

topic.label: End date time in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Activity sponsorship (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: activitySponsorship indicates the accredited provider's role in planning and presenting the activity. Direct: the accredited provider planned and presented the activity directly. Joint: together with a non-accredited provider.

topic.label: Activity sponsorship in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Participation modality (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: participationModality defines the learner's mode of participation, dictated by the activity medium.

topic.label: Participation modality in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Activity delivery (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: activityDelivery indicates the temporal nature of the activity.

topic.label: Activity delivery in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Activity format (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: activityFormat describes the type of learning activity described.

topic.label: Activity format in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Off label use (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: offLabelUse indicates whether or not this educational offering references off label usage of a drug.

topic.label: Off label use in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Off label description (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: offLabelDescription describes any off label drug use referenced in this educational offering.

topic.label: Off label description in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Commercial support (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: commercialSupport indicates the existence of any commercial support, from a manufacturer of a commercial product.

topic.label: Commercial support in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Commercial support acknowledgement (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: commercialSupportAcknowledgement describes the commercial support provided from a manufacturer of a commercial product.

topic.label: Commercial support acknowledgement in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Relevant financial relationship (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: relevantFinancialRelationship indicates the existence of any relevant financial interest or other relationship of a faculty member or other person in a position to influence the activity content with the manufacturer of any commercial product referenced in this activity.

topic.label: Relevant financial relationship in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Relevant financial relationship disclosure (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: relevantFinancialRelationshipDisclosure describes any relevant financial interest or other relationship of a faculty member or other person in a position to influence the activity content with the manufacturer of any commercial product referenced in this activity.

topic.label: Relevant financial relationship disclosure in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Contact (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: Contact identifies the person or organization that serves as the main point of contact for questions about the learning content.

context.title: Accrediting body (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: accreditingBody identifies the organization that sets the quality standards for continuing education and is the source of the accreditation process for the provider of this educational activity.

topic.label: Accrediting body in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Activity certification (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: activityCertification identifies the category of credit awarded for the activity by the accredited medical education organization.

topic.label: Activity certification in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Credit type (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: creditType indicates which type of credit is awarded for this educational activity.

topic.label: Credit type in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Credit unit (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: creditUnit indicates the unit of credit for this credit definition.

topic.label: Credit unit in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Pacing (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: pacing indicates who controls the pacing of the activity.

context.title: Accredited provider (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: accreditedProvider defines the entity serving as the accredited provider for this activity.

topic.label: Accredited provider in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Non accredited provider (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: nonAccreditedProvider defines an educational provider for this activity that is not the accredited provider. Jointly sponsored activities have a non-accredited provider.

topic.label: Non accredited provider in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Release date (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: releaseDate identifies the date this activity becomes available for credit.

topic.label: Release date in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Credit expiration date (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: expirationDate identifies the date that the activity ceases to be available for credit.

topic.label: Credit expiration date in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Number of credits (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: numberOfCredits identifies the number of continuing education credits associated with this learning activity.

topic.label: Number of credits in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Audience category (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: audienceCategory describes the intended audience for the educational offering in broad terms.

topic.label: Audience category in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Profession (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: profession describes the health profession for which this educational offering is intended. For example, physician, registered nurse, etc.

context.title: Specialty (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: specialty describes healthcare specialties within a profession that compose part of the target audience for this educational offering. For example, cardiology.

context.title: Reading level (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: readingLevel describes the primary/secondary school grade reflecting the reading level of the target audience. This is normally used for non-professional education.

topic.label: Reading level in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Room (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: Room defines the room in which an activity takes place.

context.title: Building (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: Building defines the building in which an activity takes place.

context.title: Country (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: The country of the activity location. The MedBiquitous address schema requires a country (name and/or ISO 3166 code) whenever an activity location is given.

context.title: Healthcare asset (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: healthcareAsset provides more information about images and other files that contribute to the creation of an educational offering.

topic.label: Healthcare asset in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Annotated (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: annotated indicates whether or not this resource features an annotated or labeled image.

context.title: Clinical history (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: clinicalHistory describes the clinical history of the patient or subject described in this resource.

topic.label: Clinical history in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Magnification (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: magnification describes the magnification of microscopic image(s) found in this resource. For example, 100.

context.title: Orientation (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: orientation describes the orientation of image(s) found in this resource.

context.title: Medical image type (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: medicalImageType describes the type of image, radiological or otherwise, featured in this resource.

topic.label: Medical image type in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Specimen type (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: specimenType describes the type of specimen featured in this resource.

topic.label: Specimen type in the HLOM Guide

context.title: File height (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: fileHeight describes the height of the image in pixels.

topic.label: File height in the HLOM Guide

context.title: File width (Healthcare (quoted from the HLOM specification))
context.description: fileWidth describes the width of the image in pixels.

topic.label: File width in the HLOM Guide
